name: Aperio Cisco WebEx
author: Aperio Contributors
description: Generate Cisco WebEx meeting links via the WebEx Meetings REST API. Uses a separate WebEx OAuth flow per account.

en.account.client_id.hint: From your integration on developer.webex.com. Its redirect URI must be http://127.0.0.1:8080/oauth/webex.
en.account.client_id.label: Client ID
en.account.client_secret.hint: Kept in the system keychain, never in the account database — Webex requires one even under PKCE.
en.account.client_secret.label: Client secret
en.account.site_url.hint: Leave blank. Aperio picks up your account's default site with the first meeting; an entry only matters if your organisation has several.
en.account.site_url.label: Webex site
en.join.password.phone: Password for phones and video systems
en.join.video: Join from a video system or application

de.account.client_id.hint: Aus deiner Integration auf developer.webex.com. Als Redirect-URI muss dort http://127.0.0.1:8080/oauth/webex hinterlegt sein.
de.account.client_id.label: Client-ID
de.account.client_secret.hint: Wird im Schlüsselbund des Systems abgelegt, nie in der Kontodatenbank — Webex verlangt es auch bei PKCE.
de.account.client_secret.label: Client-Secret
de.account.site_url.hint: Leer lassen. Aperio übernimmt beim ersten Meeting die Standard-Site deines Kontos; ein Eintrag lohnt nur, wenn deine Organisation mehrere hat.
de.account.site_url.label: Webex-Site
